label: c-refuter-4
tail:
No fatal or reportable nonfatal defect was found in the ten assigned items.

Key checks:

- The idempotent-monad equivalence closes the complete cycle:
  \(1\Rightarrow2\) componentwise isomorphism implies monicity;
  \(2\Rightarrow3\) cancels \(\mu_A\) from the two unit laws;
  \(3\Rightarrow1\) uses naturality of \(\eta\) at \(\mu_A\) to prove that \(\eta_{TA}\) is the two-sided inverse of \(\mu_A\).
- For idempotent algebras, both directions of the iff and uniqueness hold. The full subcategory consists precisely of objects with invertible unit, and the universal factorization through \(\eta_A\) gives \(T\) as the left-adjoint reflector.
- The reflective-subcategory theorem proves the comparison functor is an equivalence, exactly matching the repository’s non-strict definition of “monadic”; it does not claim or rely on an isomorphism of categories.
- For the distributive-law theorem:
  - the lifted algebra unit uses \(\lambda\eta^S T=T\eta^S\);
  - lifted algebra associativity uses \(\lambda\mu^S T=T\mu^S\circ\lambda S\circ S\lambda\);
  - \(\eta^T\) being an algebra homomorphism uses \(\lambda S\eta^T=\eta^T S\);
  - \(\mu^T\) being an algebra homomorphism uses \(\lambda S\mu^T=\mu^T S\circ T\lambda\circ\lambda T\);
  - functoriality uses naturality of \(\lambda\).
- The composite Eilenberg–Moore adjunction induces \(TS\), not \(ST\). Its initially computed multiplication is
  \[
  \mu^T S\circ TT\mu^S\circ T\lambda S,
  \]
  and naturality of \(\mu^T\) at \(\mu^S_A:S^2A\to SA\) gives
  \[
  \mu^T S\circ TT\mu^S
  =T\mu^S\circ\mu^T SS,
  \]
  exactly producing the multiplication in the Statement. This agrees with [Cheng, Definition 2.1 and Theorem 2.2](https://compositionality.episciences.org/13507/pdf).
- The monad-morphism identity, composition, algebra restriction, and free-algebra comparison equations all type-check componentwise.
- No assigned item depends on an `ai-generated` Statement or Construction. One target has an AI-generated proof, which is permitted and is not used as a dependency target.

Boundary checks passed: the empty category, a zero object where present, the terminal/zero category with the identity monad, and the degenerate cases \(S=1\), \(T=1\), and \(\lambda=1\). There are no families or numerical parameters in these items, so empty-index, \(n=0\), and \(n=1\) cases do not arise. Both directions of every iff and every implication in the three-way equivalence were checked.

Coverage: I read all ten assigned items in full and checked every numbered step against all 17 direct dependency files on disk. No assigned item or dependency was merely sampled, and nothing in the requested scope was unavailable or left unchecked.
